body:
Never had taken a Valium before but I did plenty of research before buying some off my friend. Bought 2 5mg tablets. Woke up ready for the experience, took one tablet, waited around watching tv, decided that smoking a bowl would be nice way to set it off, kinda started to feel a nice feeling and decided to kick it up a notch and take another 5mg tablet and sipped some moonshine afterwards...like than 5 minutes later I was feeling an overwhelming feeling in my body, I was moving extremely slow against my will. Probably the happiest feeling I've ever felt right behind the feeling of acid trips. Usually with my body weight being so high it takes a lot to get me fucked up but this definitely did the job. You're not suppose to mix valium with alcohol but hey, it worked very well.
